svg.title: The unshifted coreflector and the shifted curve transpose
svg.desc: The normalized D-module unit on a smooth projective curve is O[1], whereas the proper integral is Hom from O[-1]. Under the canonical ind-connection tensor pairing and the proper D-module pairing, the transpose of the inclusion is t=g[2]. Membership uses unshifted g. Every coordinate comparison has the exact cardinal shift; the projective-line diagonal gives E[-2] under two coreflectors and E under one coreflector and one transpose. The actual Ran coefficient action uses t at every parameter coordinate.
svg.text: The membership coreflector and the proper-integral transpose
Smooth projective complex curves; every genus; full unbounded operator parameters.
1. Absolute degrees distinguish the two proper-curve objects — NTR.1–NTR.4
p_*(N) = RHom(D(X))(k(X),N), D-dual(iP) = i(P dual)[−2].
RHom(D(X))(i(P dual),N) = p_*(iP ⊗! N)[−2].
On P¹: End(ω)=E has degrees 0,2; p_*ω=E[2] has degrees −2,0.
E=C[η]/η², |η|=2. Equal parity or dimension does not identify these complexes.
2. Membership uses g; integral pairing uses t=g[2] — NTR.5–NTR.8
i ⊣ g, g i = id, ig → id; t = g[2], t i = [2].
Γ(I)(P ⊗ tN) = RHom(D(X))(i(P dual),N)[2] = p_*(iP ⊗! N).
N belongs to i(I) exactly when igN → N is an equivalence.
The shifted functor it is not the membership coreflector.
The full Betti membership adjunction i∞ ⊣ g∞ stays unshifted.
3. The exact shift for every coordinate map — NTR.9–NTR.12
t⊗ᴶ² Δ(β)_* = δ(I)ᵝ t⊗ᴶ¹, Γ(I)t = p_*.
g⊗ᴶ² Δ(β)_* = δ(I)ᵝ g⊗ᴶ¹ [ 2(|J₁|−|J₂|) ].
Empty target coordinates: +2. Binary diagonal: −2. Bijections: 0.
Cardinal differences add under composition: every full string has the same shift.
K(I) = (g ⊗ t)K(D) = (t ⊗ g)K(D), K(D)=Δ_*ω.
4. All Ran parameters use the actual tensor transpose — NTR.13–NTR.16
Φ(V,N;m) = Φ(I)(V,t⊗ᴶN;m), L(I) Q(Ran) = L(r).
The abstract equivalence L(I) : R(I) ≃ QCoh(Z restricted) has full unbounded scope.
Its transported geometric action gives Π restricted to N ≃ id(N), EssIm(Π)=N.
N is the full Hecke-lisse category; nilpotent support and regularity need their criteria.
5. Three projective-line checks — NTR.17–NTR.25
Counit: Γ(I)gω = E, Γ(I)tω = E[2] = p_*ω.
Diagonal: (g ⊗ g)Δ_*ω = E[−2], (t ⊗ t)Δ_*ω = E[2].
Mixed diagonal: (g ⊗ t)Δ_*ω = E = (t ⊗ g)Δ_*ω.
Derived residue of E[−2] over E⊗E = direct sum of C[−n−2], n≥0.
It has nonzero cohomology in every degree ≥2, so this compact input has noncompact image.
(ig)²=ig, but (it)²ω=ω[4] differs from itω=ω[2].
Exact proofs: §§3.232–3.238, NTR.1–NTR.25; Solutions3.DS–3.DU.
The finite Spencer complexes and full proper duality determine every displayed shift.
Earlier proof inputs: §§3.48–3.52, RSC.17–RSC.18 and HLA.17–HLA.18.
The original unshifted membership counits and the abstract restricted equivalence are distinct.
